messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- The product catalog is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-12-19, having moved from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team is taking over the event bus from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team on-call rotation, taking over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-06-19, taking over from Priya Raman. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman is on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-05-13, taking over from Tomasz. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz is on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Tomasz is off the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team still owns the bus. [valid 2025-08-15 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2]
- The indexer was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder, until ownership transferred to the Boreal team on 2026-04-01. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog still relies on the image resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2025-12-18 the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every product catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
- Dashboards and alerts for the product catalog are being repointed as of the 2025-12-19 handover. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager as of 2025-09-05, taking over from Diego. [valid 2025-09-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-05]
    earlier: Diego has the Cinder pager as of 2025-07-17, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-09-05; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-17]
    earlier: Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle as of 2025-06-06, taking over from Diego. [valid 2025-06-06 to 2025-07-17; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-06-06]
    earlier: Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle as of 2025-04-24, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-04-24 to 2025-06-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24]
    earlier: Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle as of 2025-02-27, taking over from Diego. [valid 2025-02-27 to 2025-04-24; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-27]
    earlier: Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-09]

Question: When did Atlas take over the catalog?
